S043.name: Restrictive_Intake
S043.description: Persistent restriction of energy intake relative to requirements, leading to significantly low body weight.

subtypes.Eating Very Small Amounts: Eating only one or two bites a day or extremely small portions per meal.
subtypes.Skipping Meals: Intentionally skipping breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
subtypes.Exclusion of Specific Food Groups: Strictly avoiding specific food groups like carbohydrates or fats to prevent nutritional imbalance.
subtypes.Strict Calorie Restriction: Limiting daily caloric intake to an extremely low level.

S044.name: Low_Weight
S044.description: A body weight that is significantly below the minimum level of health for age, sex, developmental trajectory, and physical health.

subtypes.Continuous Weight Loss: A state where weight continues to decrease due to intentional restriction of intake.
subtypes.Insistence on Low Weight: Attempting to lose more weight or refusing to restore weight despite already being underweight.

S045.name: Fear_of_Weight_Gain
S045.description: Intense fear of gaining weight or of becoming fat, even though at a significantly low weight.

subtypes.Fear of Weight Gain: Extreme fear and loathing of gaining weight or becoming fat.
subtypes.Fear of Specific Foods: Fear that eating high-calorie foods will immediately lead to weight gain.
subtypes.Obsession with Weight Gain: Compulsively checking the scale and becoming extremely anxious about even the slightest increase.

S046.name: Body_Image_Weight_Shape_Disturbance
S046.description: Undue influence of body weight or shape on self-evaluation.

subtypes.Distorted Body Image: Perceiving one's body as much fatter than it actually is or perceiving specific parts as excessively large when looking in the mirror.
subtypes.Self-Worth Dependent on Weight: Judging whether one is a good or successful person solely based on weight or body shape.

S084.name: Low_Weight_Severity_Non_Recognition
S084.description: Persistent lack of recognition of the seriousness of the current low body weight.

subtypes.Denial of Medical Risk: Not admitting or dismissing the health risks caused by being underweight.
subtypes.Disregard of Symptoms: Not taking physical symptoms caused by low weight (dizziness, hair loss, amenorrhea) seriously.
subtypes.Dismissal of Concerns: Exaggerating or rejecting the concerns of doctors or family as unnecessary.

symptom.disease_info: Anorexia Nervosa is defined by persistent restriction of energy intake leading to significantly low body weight, accompanied by intense fear of weight gain or persistent behavior that interferes with weight restoration. It is distinguished by the undue influence of body weight or shape on self-evaluation and, often, limited recognition of the medical seriousness of low weight; its course may be gradual, hidden, and reinforced by perceived self-control or achievement.

patient.stressor_event: Death of a close family member
patient.stressor: After the death of his younger sister, Randall became newly preoccupied with aging, discipline, and not becoming a burden to his wife, reframing small meals as a sensible way to stay light on his feet for gardening, walking, and community tours. Over an unclear period, this narrowed into persistent restriction of intake, and his weight dropped significantly below what was medically safe for his age and health. He increasingly treated thinness as evidence of modesty and self-command, feared that regaining weight would mean decline, and dismissed his wife’s concern by saying people their age were supposed to eat less. After his primary care physician found no medical explanation for the low weight and Randall still denied its seriousness, he was referred for geriatric psychiatric evaluation.

S043.name: Restrictive_Intake
S043.description: Persistent restriction of energy intake relative to requirements, leading to significantly low body weight.
S043.manifestation: I suppose what brings me in is my wife thinks I'm not eating enough, but most days I just have coffee and toast in the morning, maybe some soup or vegetables later, because big meals feel unnecessary at my age.

S044.name: Low_Weight
S044.description: A body weight that is significantly below the minimum level of health for age, sex, developmental trajectory, and physical health.
S044.manifestation: My doctor says the number on the scale has gotten too low, but to me being lighter makes it easier to get around the garden and keep up on my walks.

S045.name: Fear_of_Weight_Gain
S045.description: Intense fear of gaining weight or of becoming fat, even though at a significantly low weight.
S045.manifestation: When my wife tries to put butter on things or serves me a full plate, I get nervous that I'll start putting weight back on and lose the control I've worked to keep.

S046.name: Body_Image_Weight_Shape_Disturbance
S046.description: Undue influence of body weight or shape on self-evaluation.
S046.manifestation: If my belt feels a notch looser I feel like I've done right by myself, but if my stomach looks the least bit rounded in the mirror I feel sloppy and disappointed.

S084.name: Low_Weight_Severity_Non_Recognition
S084.description: Persistent lack of recognition of the seriousness of the current low body weight.
S084.manifestation: I don't really see why everyone is making such a fuss about my weight, since older folks are supposed to eat less and I'm still managing my chores and tours.

add_requirements.functional_impairment: I still keep up with most chores, but my wife has started cutting our outings short or insisting I sit out community tours because she worries I have not eaten enough.
